Class Image

java.lang.Object
icyllis.modernui.graphics.Image
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class Image extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Image describes a two-dimensional array of pixels to sample from. The pixels may be located in CPU memory, in GPU memory as a GPU texture, or be lazily-generated.
  • Image cannot be modified by CPU or GPU after it is created.
  • Image width and height are greater than zero.
  • Image may be created from Bitmap, Surface, Picture and GPU texture.

  • Method Details

    • createTextureFromBitmap

      @Nullable public static Image createTextureFromBitmap(@Nullable Bitmap bitmap)
      Creates an image backed by a GPU texture from the given bitmap.

      If you want to create an image for a specific sub-region of the given bitmap, you should first call Bitmap.subImage(int, int, int, int) to obtain the sub-image view, and then pass the resulting bitmap to this method.

      The bitmap may be safely closed after this call returns, regardless of whether it is immutable. However, it must remain open during the execution of this call.

      As of version 3.13.0, this method is thread-safe and can be invoked from any thread except the internal rendering thread. Note that calling this from a non-UI thread will block the caller until the operation is completed on the UI thread.

      Legacy Note (Pre-3.13.0): This method was restricted to the UI thread and required both the render and UI systems to be fully initialized before invocation.

      This method may return null if:

      • The bitmap is null or already closed.
      • The GPU device is lost or disconnected.
      • The GPU device is not yet initialized.
      • The width or height of the bitmap exceeds the maximum texture dimension supported by the GPU.
      • The bitmap format is not supported (directly or indirectly) by the GPU.
      • Failed to allocate sufficient GPU-only memory for the texture.
      • Failed to allocate sufficient host memory for the staging buffer.
      • The UI thread is quitting.
      Parameters:
      bitmap - the source bitmap
      Returns:
      the created image, or null if the operation failed.

    • createTextureFromBitmap

      @Experimental @Nullable public static Image createTextureFromBitmap(@NonNull RecordingContext recordingContext, @NonNull Bitmap bitmap)
      Create an image that backed by a GPU texture with the given bitmap. Whether the bitmap is immutable or not, the bitmap can be safely closed after the call.
      Parameters:

      bitmap - the source bitmap
      Returns:

      Throws:

      IllegalStateException - not call from context thread, or no context

    • isPremultiplied

      public boolean isPremultiplied()
      Indicates whether the pixels stored in this bitmap are stored in a premultiplied format.

      When a pixel is premultiplied, the RGB components have already been multiplied by the alpha component. For instance, if the original color is a 50% translucent red (1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.5), its premultiplied form is (0.5, 0.0, 0.0, 0.5).

      Returns:
      true if the underlying pixels are premultiplied, false otherwise
      Since:
      3.13.0

    • close

      public void close()
      Perform a deferred cleanup if the underlying resource is not released. Manually mark the underlying resources closed, if needed. After this, you will not be able to operate this object, and its GPU resource will be reclaimed as soon as possible after use.

      If this Image object was not created by you (for example, from Resources), then you must not call this method.

      When this object becomes phantom-reachable, the system will automatically do this cleanup operation.

      This method is thread safe and can be called multiple times.

      Specified by:
      close in interface AutoCloseable

    • clone

      @NonNull public final Image clone()
      Create a shallow copy of this image, this is equivalent to creating a shared owner for the image. You may change the density or close the returned Image without affecting the original Image.

      This method is rarely used. If this image originates from the Resources API and you wish to manage its lifecycle yourself, set the needNewInstance of Resources.getImage(ResourceId, boolean) to true instead of calling this method. If you created the image yourself, this method is typically unnecessary unless you intend to pass it to another owner; in cases where both you and the new owner will close their respective objects, using this method ensures mutual independence and timely release.

      This method is thread safe.

      Overrides:
      clone in class Object
      Returns:
      a shallow copy of image
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - this image is already closed
